name: Chris
source:
A turbulent man who is nosy and pretends to be righteous, just like a typical protagonist. He is exceptionally skilled at playing mind games. However, he is still at an age where friends are better than love.

[From [url=https://how-to-grow-a-man.fandom.com/wiki/Chris]How to Grow a Man Wiki[/url]]
